products.name: Smokey Bones Restaurants
products.description: A full-service, meat-centric casual dining restaurant brand specializing in slow-smoked, fire-grilled meats, award-winning ribs, and a full bar with specialty cocktails and local craft beers. Delivered through company-owned and franchised restaurants, requiring physical locations, in-person service, and regulated food and beverage operations.

products.name: Restaurant Franchising Services
products.description: Franchise sales and ongoing support for Twin Peaks and Smokey Bones restaurant concepts, including training, site selection, marketing, and operational assistance. Delivered through franchise agreements, requiring business development, training programs, and brand management infrastructure.

products.name: Brewpub and Proprietary Beer Production
products.description: Production of proprietary signature beers at Twin Peaks Brewing Co., an in-house brewery supplying Twin Peaks restaurants in Texas. Requires physical brewing facilities, regulated alcohol production, and distribution to restaurant locations.

products.name: Event and Catering Services
products.description: Provision of catering, pick-up, delivery, and special event hosting at Smokey Bones and Twin Peaks restaurants, including large parties and in-restaurant events. Delivered through restaurant staff and facilities, requiring logistics, food preparation, and event management.

products.name: Bicycle Drug Conjugates (BDC molecules)
products.description: Fully synthetic, chemically conjugated molecules that link a Bicycle peptide to a cytotoxin payload for targeted cancer therapy. Manufactured via synthetic chemistry and delivered intravenously, these are evaluated in clinical trials for solid tumors and other cancers.

products.name: Bicycle Radioconjugates (BRC molecules)
products.description: Theranostic agents consisting of a Bicycle molecule chemically linked to a radioisotope payload for targeted radiopharmaceutical therapy and imaging in oncology. Produced synthetically and administered intravenously, with supply chain arrangements for isotopes.

products.name: Bicycle Imaging Agents (BIA molecules)
products.description: Synthetic Bicycle molecules linked to radiopharmaceutical imaging agents for use in PET/SPECT imaging to identify and triage cancer indications. Manufactured via chemical synthesis and used in human imaging studies.

products.name: Bicycle Tumor-Targeted Immune Cell Agonists (Bicycle TICA molecules)
products.description: Synthetic molecules that link immune cell receptor-binding Bicycle peptides to tumor antigen-binding Bicycle peptides, designed to activate immune responses against tumors. Produced via chemical synthesis and evaluated in clinical trials for immuno-oncology.

products.name: Partnered Bicycle Molecule Therapeutics (non-oncology)
products.description: Therapeutic candidates developed in collaboration with biopharmaceutical partners, applying the proprietary Bicycle screening platform to targets in CNS, neuromuscular, cardiometabolic, and other disease areas. These are developed using synthetic chemistry and advanced through preclinical and clinical stages by partners.

products.name: Radiopharmaceutical Supply and Development Services (for partners)
products.description: Provision of research, discovery, and development services to partners (e.g., Bayer) to generate radiopharmaceutical compounds incorporating optimized Bicycle constructs for specified targets, including supply chain and manufacturing arrangements for radioisotopes.

products.name: Product Packaging and Security Printing
products.description: Manufactures and sells custom folding cartons, mailers, photo sleeves, and complex direct mail solutions, as well as document security printing and active/intelligent packaging. Production is physical, requiring specialized manufacturing equipment and compliance with sustainability and regulatory standards.

products.name: Biotechnology Products and Licensing
products.description: Develops, patents, and licenses healthcare-related products including therapeutic drug platforms, sugar substitutes, functional fragrances, bioplastics, and antimicrobial/insect repellent compounds. Delivery is through R&D, partnerships, and licensing, with some products manufactured for direct or partner distribution.

products.name: Commercial Lending and Financial Services
products.description: Provides commercial loans, business lines of credit, land development and inventory financing, equipment financing, and third-party loan servicing. Services are delivered through a financial network holding company structure, requiring financial capital and regulatory compliance.

products.name: Securities and Investment Management
products.description: Offers securities trading, broker-dealer services, investment advisory, and manages real estate investment trusts (REITs) and other investment funds. Services are delivered via regulated platforms and subsidiaries, including real estate acquisition and leasing for healthcare properties.

products.name: Oral Small Molecule GLP-1 Receptor Agonists
products.description: Oral small molecule drugs targeting the glucagon-like-peptide-1 receptor (GLP-1R), developed using structure-based drug discovery and computational chemistry, for the treatment of obesity, overweight, type 2 diabetes, and related cardiometabolic diseases. These are manufactured via scalable chemical synthesis and delivered as oral tablets or capsules.

products.name: Oral Small Molecule Amylin Receptor Agonists
products.description: Oral small molecule drugs targeting the amylin receptor, including dual amylin and calcitonin receptor agonists (DACRA), for the treatment of obesity and type 2 diabetes. These are developed using structure-based drug discovery and manufactured via chemical synthesis for oral administration.

products.name: Oral Small Molecule GIP and Glucagon Receptor Modulators
products.description: Oral small molecule drugs targeting the glucose-dependent insulinotropic polypeptide receptor (GIPR) and glucagon receptor (GCGR), including dual and tri-agonists, for potential combination therapy in obesity, type 2 diabetes, and metabolic diseases. These are discovered using structure-based and computational chemistry approaches and manufactured for oral delivery.

products.name: Oral Small Molecule APJ Receptor Agonists
products.description: Oral small molecule drugs targeting the APJ receptor, developed for potential use in pulmonary arterial hypertension, idiopathic pulmonary fibrosis, and as combination therapies for selective or muscle-sparing weight loss. These are discovered using structure-based drug design and manufactured for oral administration.

products.name: Oral Small Molecule LPA1 Receptor Antagonists
products.description: Oral small molecule antagonists targeting the lysophosphatidic acid 1 receptor (LPA1R), developed for the treatment of idiopathic pulmonary fibrosis (IPF) and other fibrotic diseases. These are discovered using structure-based drug discovery and manufactured for oral administration.

products.name: Electronic Door Locking Products
products.description: Manufactures and sells a variety of electronic and mechanical door locking devices, including standalone and networked digital door locks, panic devices, door closers, and microprocessor-based locks with push button, card reader, and biometric operation. These are physically manufactured and delivered to commercial, institutional, and residential customers.

products.name: Intrusion and Fire Alarm Systems
products.description: Designs, manufactures, and sells intrusion and fire alarm systems, including control panels, area detectors, digital keypads, and signaling equipment. These systems are physically installed at customer sites and require both hardware manufacturing and integration.

products.name: Cellular Communication Devices and Services
products.description: Provides cellular communication devices and recurring monthly cloud-based communication services for intrusion and fire alarm systems, enabling secure alarm signal transmission and remote monitoring. Services are delivered digitally and generate recurring revenue.

products.name: Access Control Systems and Hosted Services
products.description: Manufactures and sells access control systems, including door controllers, identification readers, and hosted cloud-based services for managing access. These systems combine physical hardware with digital management platforms for secure facility access.

products.name: Video Surveillance Systems
products.description: Designs, engineers, and markets video surveillance systems, including cameras, control panels, monitors, recording devices, and remote communication capabilities. These systems are a mix of manufactured and resold components, delivered as integrated security solutions.

products.name: School Security Solutions
products.description: Provides integrated security solutions tailored for schools and public spaces, including specialized door locks, wireless locking systems, and enterprise access control for campus-wide lockdowns. These solutions combine manufactured hardware and digital services, delivered through projects and installations.

products.name: Specialty Insurance Risk Exchange Services
products.description: A technology-driven platform that connects specialty insurance underwriters (MGAs) with risk capital providers (insurers, reinsurers, institutional investors), providing data-driven sourcing, management, and monitoring of specialty insurance portfolios. Delivered digitally via proprietary software and analytics, with recurring fee-based revenue from capital partners.

products.name: MGA Formation and Incubation Services
products.description: Turnkey support for entrepreneurial underwriters to launch and operate new Managing General Agencies (MGAs), including start-up financing, underwriting capacity, operational resources, and regulatory support. products.name: Equity Investment in MGAs
products.description: Minority or majority equity investments in select MGAs, aligning interests and capturing value from their growth. Involves financial capital and ongoing operational collaboration, with revenue from equity income and commissions.

products.name: Specialty Insurance Underwriting and Retained Risk
products.description: Direct underwriting of specialty insurance policies through owned insurance carriers, retaining a portion of risk and associated underwriting profit. Requires regulatory licenses, capital reserves, and in-person insurance operations.

products.name: Reinsurance and Risk Capital Access Services
products.description: Facilitation of reinsurance and risk capital access for insurance companies and institutional investors, including structuring quota share and excess of loss arrangements, and operating reinsurance vehicles like Flywheel Re. products.name: Data, Analytics, and AI-Driven Insurance Insights
products.description: Provision of actionable data, analytics, and AI-driven insights to underwriters and risk capital partners, supporting underwriting, portfolio management, and claims analysis. Delivered digitally via proprietary SaaS platform and workflow tools.

products.name: Blackbox System Platform (Trading Analytics and Social Community)
products.description: A subscription-based, web and mobile SaaS platform providing real-time proprietary analytics, algorithmic alerts, market data, and a fully integrated social media community for stock and options traders. products.name: Blackbox Academy (Paid Educational Courses)
products.description: A suite of paid online educational courses and webinars on trading and market-related topics, offered to both members and non-members. Courses are delivered digitally and include live and recorded instruction for various skill levels.

products.name: Stock Nanny Mobile App
products.description: A standalone mobile application for iOS and Android that provides real-time, customizable portfolio alerts and integrates with online brokerage accounts for self-directed investors. Delivered digitally, it targets a broader retail investor segment beyond active traders.

products.name: Enterprise and Institutional Trading Solutions
products.description: Custom trading analytics solutions and API data access for professional traders and financial institutions, leveraging the Blackbox System’s technology and data. products.name: Rugged Edge Servers

products.name: GPU Compute Acceleration Systems
products.description: Systems and appliances integrating multiple GPUs for high-performance parallel processing, AI/ML, and compute acceleration, optimized for rugged edge environments and leveraging the latest GPU technologies.

products.name: High-Density Flash Storage Arrays and Storage Servers

products.description: Proprietary software solutions, including Ion Accelerator™, for managing, optimizing, and securing high-performance flash storage systems, supporting features such as NVMe over Fabrics, encryption, and removable media management for edge and mission-critical applications.

products.name: Unified Baseboard Management Controller (U-BMC) Software

products.description: Produces and sells household and outdoor pest control solutions (insecticides, foggers, repellents), weed control, animal repellents, and household cleaning and restoration products (liquids, mops, wipes). products.description: Development and sale of advanced driver assistance and full self-driving software features, delivered digitally via over-the-air updates and available as subscriptions or paid upgrades for Tesla vehicles.

products.name: Energy Storage Systems

products.name: Energy Generation Systems (Solar Panels and Solar Roof)

products.name: Energy System Financing and Power Purchase Agreements (PPAs)

products.name: Automotive Maintenance and Repair Services
products.description: Provision of non-warranty maintenance, repair, and collision services for Tesla vehicles at company-owned service centers and via mobile service technicians.

products.name: Energy Product Maintenance and Repair Services
products.description: Provision of service, repairs, and warranty support for Tesla energy generation and storage products, including installation workmanship warranties.

products.name: Automotive Parts and Retail Merchandise Sales

products.description: Digital solutions for healthcare systems to manage clinician coverage, including on-demand patient routing, shared coverage models, and integration with external medical groups. Delivered via software to optimize staffing and reduce reliance on locum tenens.

products.description: Software and device integration enabling live streaming of medical peripherals (e.g., otoscopes, stethoscopes) and remote monitoring of patient vitals, allowing clinicians to conduct exams and monitor patients outside traditional settings. products.description: AI-powered and remote nursing solutions for event monitoring, virtual fencing, fall prevention, and remote admission/discharge, augmenting bedside nursing staff. Delivered via digital platform with AI and remote human labor.

products.description: Remote specialty physician consultations (e-consults) in over 14 specialties (e.g., mental health, cardiology, oncology) for correctional facilities and other clients, delivered via secure telemedicine platform and physician network.

products.description: AI-driven software for time capture, billing automation, and compliance with client requirements. products.name: Collaboration and Document Management Solutions
products.description: Cloud-based tools that integrate with Microsoft 365, Teams, and SharePoint to provide unified management of emails, documents, chats, and tasks. products.name: Applied AI and Automation Solutions
products.description: Embedded AI capabilities and automation tools, including Intapp Assist and DealCloud Activator, that provide advanced analytics, workflow automation, generative AI features, and actionable insights across the Intapp platform to optimize business processes and decision-making.

products.name: Data Management and Integration Solutions
products.description: Cloud-based data foundation and integration tools that securely manage, integrate, and analyze proprietary and third-party data. products.description: Origination of loans secured by five or more unit residential buildings, primarily adjustable-rate, for property acquisition or refinancing. products.description: Offering a variety of deposit accounts to individuals and businesses, including checking, savings, money market, certificates of deposit, and IRAs. Delivered through physical branches and digital banking platforms, with regulatory insurance coverage.

products.description: Provision of cash management solutions for business customers, including digital and mobile banking applications, designed to facilitate business banking and accelerate core deposit growth. Delivered digitally and through relationship managers.

products.description: Merchant acquiring and payment processing solutions for small businesses nationwide, including credit card, debit card, and ACH transaction processing. products.name: Traditional Community Banking Services
products.description: A suite of traditional banking products for businesses and consumers, including checking, savings, money market, and certificates of deposit, as well as commercial and consumer loans. products.name: Real Estate Lending

products.description: Project management, construction, installation, maintenance, repair, and emergency response services for power distribution and information, communications, and data networks. products.description: An AI-powered platform unifying security operations, including SIEM, endpoint security, security automation, cloud detection and response, and attack surface management. products.description: A cloud-native application protection platform (CNAPP) providing security across the cloud application development lifecycle, including code, infrastructure, and runtime protection for multi- and hybrid-cloud environments. products.name: AI Security Platform (Prisma AIRS)
products.description: A platform engineered to protect customers' AI ecosystems, providing AI model scanning, posture management, red teaming, runtime security, and AI agent security. Delivered as a SaaS solution, leveraging advanced AI and machine learning.

products.description: Centralized cloud-based and on-premises management solutions for network security infrastructure, enabling unified policy, device, and log management, leveraging AI for automation and remediation. Delivered as SaaS and virtual appliances.

products.description: A digital subscription platform offering self-paced lessons, live classes with expert tutors, and community practice in 14 languages, delivered online and developed by language experts.

products.name: Workforce Skilling Programs
products.description: Online programs for businesses and individuals focused on professional upskilling, including technical skills (AI, coding, data analytics, cybersecurity) and business/durable skills, delivered through modular online content, practice opportunities, and real-time progress tracking.

products.name: Academic Learning Services (Chegg Study Pack)
products.description: A bundled digital subscription service for students that includes Chegg Study, Chegg Writing, and Chegg Math, providing AI-driven, step-by-step learning support, writing tools, and math problem-solving engines, all delivered online.

products.name: Programmatic Advertising Services
products.description: Online advertising services leveraging programmatic technology, data analytics, and machine learning to deliver and optimize digital ad impressions across Chegg's platforms.

products.name: Tokenized Real-World Asset (RWA) Products
products.description: Forum originates, structures, and tokenizes income-generating real-world assets (such as auto loans, manufactured home loans, equipment finance assets, and real estate) into digital securities issued and managed on blockchain networks. These products are distributed to investors via digital and institutional capital markets, leveraging regulated infrastructure and partnerships.

products.name: Tokenization and Digital Issuance Services
products.description: Forum provides structuring, issuance, and ongoing administration services for tokenized financial products backed by real-world assets, including asset structuring, digital issuance, and management of tokenized asset programs. These services are delivered via proprietary blockchain infrastructure and partnerships with regulated trading platforms.

products.name: ETH Staking and DeFi Yield Generation
products.description: Forum deploys its ETH holdings across staking, lending, and advanced DeFi protocols to generate yield. This involves participating in Ethereum's proof-of-stake consensus mechanism, liquid staking, and partnering with DeFi protocol providers to earn rewards and transaction fees.

products.name: Asset Origination and Financing
products.description: Forum originates or acquires portfolios of real-world financial assets (such as consumer loans, equipment leases, and real estate) and provides financing for these assets, generating income through borrower payments or lease revenue. These assets may be held on balance sheet prior to tokenization or financed through various arrangements.

products.name: Conditionally Activated Cytokine Therapeutics (INDUKINE Molecules)
products.description: Systemically delivered, conditionally activated cytokine therapeutics (including IL-2, IL-12, IL-21, IL-18, IL-10, IFNα) engineered using the proprietary PREDATOR platform to activate selectively in the tumor microenvironment or disease site, aiming to stimulate immune responses for cancer and immune-mediated diseases. These are produced via protein engineering and require regulated manufacturing and clinical development.

products.name: Conditionally Activated Immune Cell Engager Therapeutics (INDUCER Molecules)
products.description: Bispecific antibody-based immune cell engager therapeutics (INDUCER molecules), including T cell engagers, designed using the PREDATOR platform to be conditionally activated in the tumor microenvironment, redirecting immune cells to cancer cells for targeted killing. These are produced via advanced antibody engineering and require regulated manufacturing and clinical development.

products.name: Partnered Conditionally Activated Cytokine Therapeutics (e.g., JZP898/WTX-613)
products.description: Conditionally activated cytokine therapeutics (e.g., IFNα INDUKINE molecules) developed using the PREDATOR platform and licensed to external pharmaceutical partners for global development and commercialization. These are produced via protein engineering and transferred to partners for further development and commercialization.

products.name: Intelligent Agreement Management (IAM) Platform
products.description: A cloud-based, AI-powered platform that manages the entire agreement lifecycle, including creation, negotiation, signing, and post-signature management. Delivered as a subscription service, it integrates workflow automation, AI analytics, and a unified agreement repository.

products.name: eSignature Solution
products.description: A digital signature product enabling secure sending and signing of agreements on various devices from anywhere in the world. Delivered as a cloud-based subscription, it includes multiple editions and add-ons for different industries and geographies.

products.name: Contract Lifecycle Management (CLM) Solution
products.description: A software solution that automates and orchestrates workflows for generating, negotiating, storing, and analyzing agreements. Delivered as a cloud-based subscription, it leverages AI for contract analytics and is available in multiple editions for varying organizational needs.

products.name: Add-on Agreement Process Products
products.description: A suite of additional cloud-based tools that enhance agreement workflows, including payment collection, identity verification, remote online notarization, web forms for contract drafting, and advanced analytics. Sold as add-ons to core subscriptions.

products.name: Professional Services (Deployment and Integration)
products.description: Consulting services for new customers, including deployment, integration, workflow design, and training to ensure successful adoption of Docusign products. Delivered by in-house experts or partners, typically as one-time or project-based engagements.

products.name: Mobile Games
products.description: A portfolio of free-to-play mobile games across casual and social casino genres, developed and operated by in-house and acquired studios, delivered digitally via app stores and online platforms. Games are continuously updated with new features, content, and live operations to drive engagement and monetization.

products.name: In-Game Virtual Items and Currency
products.description: Digital goods such as virtual coins, power-ups, boosts, and other items sold within mobile games, enabling players to enhance gameplay, progress, or personalize their experience. Delivered digitally through in-app purchases and supported by proprietary payment systems.

products.name: Live Game Operations Services for Third Parties
products.description: Proprietary technology platform and live operations services, including analytics, AI-driven personalization, marketing tools, and monetization optimization, offered to external game developers to enhance engagement and revenue in their games. Delivered as a suite of digital tools and services.

products.name: Drinkable Kefir
products.description: A cultured dairy beverage produced in various organic and non-organic sizes, flavors, and milk types, manufactured primarily at company-owned facilities and through select co-packers.

products.name: European-Style Soft Cheeses
products.description: Includes farmer cheese, white cheese, and Sweet Kiss, produced at company facilities using cultured dairy processes and distributed through retail and distributor channels.

products.name: Cream and Dairy Byproducts
products.description: Primarily cream, a byproduct of kefir production, processed and sold as a separate product line through the same distribution channels.

products.name: Drinkable Yogurt
products.description: A cultured dairy beverage similar to kefir, produced in various sizes and flavors, manufactured by co-packers and distributed through retail and distributor channels.

products.name: ProBugs Kefir for Children
products.description: A line of kefir products specifically formulated and packaged for children, produced at company facilities and distributed through standard channels.

products.name: Other Dairy Products
products.description: Includes butter and sour cream, produced under the Fresh Made brand, using traditional dairy processing methods at company facilities.

products.name: Onsite Environmental Services and Material Processing for Metals Industry
products.description: Comprehensive onsite services for the global metals industry, including resource recovery, metal recycling, slag optimization, scrap management, materials handling, logistics, and meltshop/furnace services. Delivered through long-term contracts and requiring specialized equipment, operational expertise, and regulatory compliance.

products.name: Downstream Ecoproducts (Road Materials, Metallurgical Additives, Agricultural and Cement Products)
products.description: Manufacture and sale of value-added products derived from industrial waste streams, including slag-based road surfacing materials, metallurgical additives, soil conditioners, fertilizers, and cement additives. Production involves processing steel slag and other byproducts into marketable materials for construction, agriculture, and manufacturing.

products.name: Hazardous Waste Processing, Treatment, Recycling, and Disposal
products.description: Testing, tracking, processing, recycling, and disposal of hazardous waste, including industrial wastewater, manufacturing sludge, chemicals, pharmaceuticals, and PFAS. Services are delivered through a network of RCRA Part B permitted TSDFs, wastewater treatment facilities, and specialized processing technologies, requiring regulatory compliance and specialized permits.

products.name: Soil and Dredged Materials Remediation and Beneficial Reuse
products.description: Processing, treatment, and recycling of contaminated soils and dredged materials, including stabilization, thermal desorption, and beneficial reuse as construction fill or landfill capping. Delivered via fixed and mobile plants, serving infrastructure, redevelopment, and remediation projects.

products.name: Railway Track Maintenance Equipment
products.description: Design, engineering, and manufacturing of specialized railway track maintenance equipment, including surfacing, grinding, tie, utility track vehicles, and new track construction machines. Products are manufactured in dedicated facilities and sold globally through long-term contracts and purchase orders.

products.name: Aftermarket Parts and Services for Rail Equipment
products.description: Provision of OEM replacement parts, upgrade kits, technical assistance, and training for railway maintenance equipment. Delivered through global service representatives and an e-commerce platform, supporting a large installed base of equipment.

products.name: Railway Safety and Diagnostic Technology Equipment
products.description: Development and sale of technology solutions for railway safety, measurement, and diagnostics, including collision avoidance, track geometry measurement, and analytical data systems. Products leverage AI and advanced analytics to improve operational efficiency and safety.

products.name: Railway Contracting Services
products.description: Provision of railway track maintenance services through work crews operating specialized equipment, covering large-scale maintenance and construction projects for rail operators worldwide. Services are delivered by experienced teams and often under contract.

products.name: RAS/MAPK Pathway-Targeted Oncology Therapeutics
products.description: A portfolio of precision oncology drugs designed to inhibit the RAS/MAPK signaling pathway in cancer, including small molecule inhibitors and biologic antibodies. These therapeutics are developed through clinical and preclinical programs and delivered as pharmaceutical products for the treatment of various solid tumors with RAS/MAPK pathway alterations.

products.name: Pan-RAS Inhibitors (ERAS-0015)
products.description: A clinical-stage small molecule drug (molecular glue) that targets and inhibits all RAS isoforms in RAS-mutated solid tumors. Delivered as an oral pharmaceutical, it is developed for monotherapy and combination regimens in oncology.

products.name: Pan-KRAS Inhibitors (ERAS-4001)
products.description: A clinical-stage small molecule drug that selectively inhibits KRAS-mutated proteins in solid tumors. Delivered orally, it is developed for use as a monotherapy or in combination with other agents for cancer treatment.

products.name: EGFR D2/D3 Biparatopic Antibody Therapeutics (ERAS-12)
products.description: A biologic antibody program targeting both domain II and III of the EGFR receptor, designed to inhibit EGFR signaling in tumors. Delivered as an injectable biologic, it aims to treat cancers where EGFR is a primary driver, with enhanced immune effector functions.

products.name: Oral STAT3 Inhibitor Therapeutics (TTI-101 and TTI-109)
products.description: Oral, small molecule drugs that directly inhibit STAT3, a transcription factor implicated in inflammatory and proliferative diseases. These therapeutics are developed through chemical synthesis and are delivered as oral tablets, requiring pharmaceutical manufacturing and clinical development. TTI-101 is the first-generation inhibitor, while TTI-109 is a phosphate prodrug designed to improve delivery and tolerability, both targeting STAT3-driven diseases such as hepatocellular carcinoma (HCC), idiopathic pulmonary fibrosis (IPF), and potentially other inflammatory and proliferative conditions.

products.name: Contract Manufacturing of Hydrogel Products
products.description: Manufacture and supply of custom high water content, electron beam cross-linked, aqueous polymer hydrogels to third parties for incorporation into their own products, including drug delivery, wound care, medical diagnostics, and cosmetics. Products are produced in specialized FDA-compliant facilities and shipped in bulk or as finished goods.

products.name: Branded Consumer Products
products.description: Direct sale of branded over-the-counter healthcare, skincare, and beauty products, including hydrogel-based remedies (blister and pain applications), psoriasis skincare, and beauty products such as false eyelashes, distributed via e-commerce, retail, and medical office channels. Products are manufactured using proprietary hydrogel technology.

products.name: Custom and White Label Hydrogel Products
products.description: Development and manufacturing of custom and white label finished hydrogel products for other brands, particularly in OTC, beauty, and cosmetics, allowing customers to brand and resell finished goods. Includes a process for customer-driven product customization with development fees.

products.name: Medical Device Development and Licensing
products.description: Development and preparation for licensing of medical devices that utilize hydrogel technology, such as incise surgical drapes (NEXDrape) and adhesive tapes for securing medical lines (NEXDerm). Devices are designed for gentle skin contact and infection prevention, with commercialization intended through third-party partners.
